content: The use of multiple daily injections (MDI) provides the benefit of flexible dosing, allowing for tailored insulin administration to meet individual needs. However, this approach can increase the complexity of diabetes management, particularly for older adults who may face challenges in handling intricate treatment regimens. On the other hand, fixed-combination injectable options simplify treatment regimens by providing stable dosing. These options may be more suitable for individuals with complex health needs or those who have limited capacity to manage the frequent adjustments required in intensive therapy.
